references.text: Curses for disobedience to the Lord, including a curse upon the body, similar to the disease described in the sotah test.
The people answer 'Amen' to the curses that are read aloud, just as the woman answers 'Amen, Amen' to the priest's words.
Parallel verses describing the effect of the bitter water if the woman is guilty.
The curse that enters the body like water and oil into the bones, similar to the image of the bitter water penetrating the woman's inner being.
Nehemiah uses a double 'Amen' as confirmation of an oath, just as the woman confirms with 'Amen, Amen'.
The prophet refers to answering 'Amen' to curses and blessings in the covenant.
